item.title: South Africa removed from EU's high-risk country list: A step towards economic recovery
item.description: There has been welcome reaction to last week's announcement of the removal of South Africa from the European Union’s list of “High-Risk Third Country Jurisdictions” (EU List).

item.title: Ghost of seasons past: Can the Orlando Pirates avoid another late-season collapse?
item.description: Head coach Abdeslam Ouaddou has guided Orlando Pirates to MTN8 and Carling Knockout triumphs already this season.

item.title: 2026 will be an extraordinary year for the Springboks as they plan for World Cup Australia 2027
item.description: Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus will be at the helm of the world champions until after the 2031 Rugby World Cup following a successful contract extension with SA Rugby. 2026 will be the most challenge no World Cup year for Erasmus and his Springboks.

item.title: Philander downplays burnout fears as Proteas fine-tune T20 World Cup plans
item.description: The Proteas fell just short at the 2024 T20 World Cup, losing to India in the final, and will be keen to go one step further at this year's showpiece on the subcontinent.

item.title: MKP's Leadership Under Scrutiny Amid KZN Political Turmoil
item.description: Leader of the Umkhonto We Sizwe (MKP) party and former South African president Jacob Zuma waves to supporters during the party's first anniversary celebrations at the Moses Mabhida stadium in Durban on December 15, 2024.

item.title: Bryan Habana backs Springboks' long-term strategy ahead of 2027 Rugby World Cup
item.description: Former Springbok wing Bryan Habana is anticipating another strong international season for Rassie Erasmus and the Boks as they fine-tune their plans for the 2027 Rugby World Cup with crucial Tests against England, Scotland and the All Blacks in 2026.

item.title: Failed promises: how SA's anti-racism laws fall short in 2026
item.description: A former airline employee was captured on video telling a man to “go back to India” and that Indians and the Taj Mahal “smells like sh*t”.

item.title: SPCA rescues 120 fish from neglected swimming pool in Fish Hoek
item.description: Swimming pool used as a dumping site for live fish in Fish Hoek prompts SPCA intervention, with 120 fish removed under a court order.

item.title: Sunrisers Eastern Cape wary of spin threat ahead of MI Cape Town rematch
item.description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape coach Adrian Birrell addresses his charges.

item.title: Ekurhuleni MMC missing after vehicle swept away in Mozambique floods
item.description: MMC for Roads and Transport, Andile Mngwevu, is missing after the vehicle he was travelling in was swept away by floodwaters in Chokwé, southern Mozambique.
